name: Coastal Sea Cliff Ruins
description: Weathered sandstone ruins above tide pools and breaking surf.
palette: bleached sandstone, sea foam white, deep teal water, wet slate, pale grass
lighting: bright overcast coastal daylight, cool blue shadows
aesthetics: Hand-painted fantasy cartography, rough painterly brushwork with visible strokes, strong dark ink outlines around every object and wall, subtle black and brown linework, restrained desaturated colour, carefully shaded volumetric detail, inked line art over watercolour and gouache, premium hand-drawn D&D virtual tabletop map, dense environmental storytelling
ground: sun-bleached sandstone paving worn smooth, pitted with salt and wet in patches
materials: Weathered coastal ruins on a sea cliff. Sun-bleached sandstone walls half collapsed, salt-worn stone paving, tide pools and wet dark rock, foaming surf breaking against the cliff base, tufts of hardy sea grass, scattered driftwood and barnacle-crusted debris, bleached rope and broken masonry.
boundary: broken sea cliff and tumbled rock, with open water beyond it
